sections.A: Parkinson's mein dimagh ke dopamine banane wale cells dheere dheere khatam hote hain. Is se movement aahista, chhoti aur akdi ho jati hai.
sections.B: Chhote qadmon wali ghaseet-ti chaal, baazu kam hilna, jhuka posture, qadam tez hote jana (festination) aur rukna (freezing).
sections.C: Diagnosis kab hua, dawa ka waqt aur har dose kitni der asar karti hai, freezing aur girne ki history.
sections.D: MDS-UPDRS, TUG (dual task ke saath), Mini-BESTest, gait speed aur qadam ki lambai.
sections.G: Dinon mein tezi se bigarna (infection ya dawa), ya achanak shadeed akdan, bukhar aur confusion: urgent medical.
sections.H: Shuru ke stage mein aerobic, strength, bari movements aur balance. Baad mein girne se bachao, freezing ke tareeqe aur ghar mein hifazat.
sections.I: Chhoti aahista movements ke liye amplitude training (jaise LSVT BIG); chaal ke liye cueing (awaaz, lines).
sections.K: Machines markazi nahi. Walker soch samajh kar chunein; kuch walkers freezing barha sakte hain.
sections.M: TUG, Mini-BESTest, gait speed, qadam ki lambai, freezing questionnaire aur girne ki diary.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Therapy dawa ke 'on' waqt mein karein, jab patient behtar hilta aur seekhta hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
